scope: Shape and Mask Path controls, isolated root-content RGB and alpha; not full-project preview-background alpha preservation
time_policy: frame i at i/30 seconds; authoring/editable readback separately verifies off-grid key time 0.125 seconds

alpha_critical.algorithm: rgb-rms on lossless grayscale alpha planes

alpha_convention: Adobe Lossless with Alpha uses premultiplied black; independently inspect opaque/edge samples and normalize to the same declared convention before comparing
fx_render: source-built tsrct export --format prores --fx-solo main:1 --fps 30; isolates the imported root-content Group, excluding only the diagnosed opaque preview background
prohibited: converting an FX render into an Adobe reference
